Contract Research Organization & Antibiotic Development

We develop new antibiotics and design new approaches for the in vitro evaluation of antibiotics. Our Contract Research Organization (CRO) specializes in antibiotic development services. With our team of experts, we can help you develop and bring new antibiotics to market quickly and efficiently. We offer comprehensive services for every stage of antibiotic development.

CONTACT US

Antibiotic Development

In-house antibiotic discovery programs. Antibiotic efficacy and potency testing & in vitro DMPK evaluation. With our team of experts, we can help you develop and bring new antibiotics to market quickly and efficiently.

Contract Research Organization

Our Contract Research Organization (CRO) specializes in antibiotic development services. Our unique Kinetocell technology will allow you to expand your testing with a non-animal model that reduces regulatory burdens and expenses.

Natural Product Isolation

Natural Product Isolation is an advanced solution that helps to extract pure compounds from natural sources. This technique assists researchers in preserving the quality of the products and providing an easy and efficient way of separating and purifying natural components.

Proprietary Kinetocell Technology for Humane, Animal Free Testing

We have developed a new approach to in vitro pharmaceutics experiments that replaces the animal, generates more accurate and larger quantities of data, and allows for significant reduction and replacement of animals in antibiotic discovery programs. Our system allows for proof of concept, dose optimization, pharmaceutic analysis and resistance profiling of a new antibiotic.

Controlled Studies

Unlock new frontiers in antibiotic development with controlled studies. We use specialized scientific methods to test the efficacy of your new drug candidates and develop new antibiotics faster.

Efficacy Testing

We allow people to choose the best clinical candidate from a set of possible drugs in early stage, preclinical, and pre-IND. Accelerate drug discovery with efficacy testing for antibiotic development. Our efficacy testing reduces your testing timeline and accelerates the development of new antibiotics. Maximize your drug development potential today.

Safety Testing

We provide comprehensive safety testing for antibiotic development. We specialize in rigorous safety standards and quality control to ensure the development of safe and effective antibiotics. Our experts are here to help you create a safer future for antibiotic development.
